header.running_head: Learning, Teaching and Rehearsing the Knowledge of Deen and Questions that are Appropriate and those that are Inappropriate

blocks.text: (RA) with instructions to verify the words of Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) and to then report what she said back to him. In the meantime, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) took a handful of pebbles from the ground and kept turning them over in his hand until Hadhrat Khabbaab returned. When Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) confirmed what Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) said, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) threw the pebbles down saying, "We have lost a great number of Qiraats." [^1]

Another narration adds that Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) said, "We (the poor men of Suffa) had neither plantations nor trade in the marketplaces to distract us from being with Rasulullaah ﷺ. All I did was to seek a word from Rasulullaah ﷺ to teach me or a morsel to feed me (I therefore heard a lot that others did not hear)." To this, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) remarked, "O Abu Hurayrah (RA)! You stayed more with Rasulullaah ﷺ than we did and therefore know more Ahadeeth than us." [^2]
The Statement of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) Concerning how Few Questions the Sahabah (RA) Posed to Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) said, "I have never seen people better than the Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ. Until he passed away, they did not ask him more than thirteen questions, all of which appear in the Qur'aan (Some of these are): "They (the Sahabah (RA)) ask you (O Rasulullaah ﷺ) about the sacred months", "They ask you about wine and gambling", "They ask you about orphans", "They ask you about menstruation", "They ask you about the spoils of war", "They ask you about what they should spend". The Sahabah (RA) questioned Rasulullaah ﷺ only about matters that were of benefit to them." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) stated further, "The first beings to perform Tawaaf of the Kabah were the angels. Between the Hajar (Aswad) and the Rukn Yamaani are the graves of several Ambiyaa. When any of these Ambiyaa was harassed by his people, he left them to worship Allaah here until he passed away." [^3]
The Women of the Ansaar ask Rasulullaah ﷺ Questions about Deen and Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) asks about Wet Dreams
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) said, "The women of the Ansaar were the best of women. Modesty did not prevent them from asking questions about Deen and attaining a deep understanding of Deen." [^4]
Hadhrat Ummu Sulaym (RA) narrates that she was sitting next to Rasulullaah
